tei:titleStmt.tei:title: תְּפִלָּה נֹכַח הָרָעָה מִדָּרוֹם
Mi sheBerakh in the face of the Missiles Falling on Israel (Masorti Movement in Israel 2023)

tei:div.tei:head: Mi sheBerakh in the face of the Missiles Falling on Israel (Masorti Movement in Israel 2023)

tei:lg.tei:l: May the One who blessed our patriarchs:
Avraham, Yitsḥaq, and Yaaqov
and our matriarchs:
Sarah, Rivqah, Leah, and Raḥel,
bless the inhabitants of the State of Israel
who live under the daily threat of missiles of death and destruction
and fire of hatred and loathing.
May the blessed Holy One,
strengthen their hearts
and reinforce their resilience
at this time of crisis
until the wrath passes.
May it be the will of the One who resides in the Heights
to give good counsel to the hearts of all the leaders of the State
that they know to conduct this people’s war
with wisdom, discernment and resourcefulness.
Lord of Hosts, God of the ranks of Israel,
please protect the soldiers of the Israel Defense Forces
involved in this campaign, on land, in the air, and at sea,
on the battlefront and the home front,
and the police and all security and rescue forces.
Save them, our God,
from every trouble and malevolent design,
and deliver blessing and success to the striving of their hands.
May they go out in peace
and return to their homes
alive and whole.
Our Guardian in Heaven,
bring peace to the Land and endless joy to its inhabitants
and fulfill for them, speedily in our days,
what is written in Scripture:
“But every man shall sit under his grapevine or fig tree
with no one to disturb him.
For it was the Lord of Hosts who spoke” (Micah 4:4).
May it be Your will
and let us say, Amen.
